workarounds.symptom: Rough edges projecting a large JSON source: --out ignored, relative --schema, list-valued refs, get_impact arg
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Honor positional MCP sources and export JSON projections without mounting. Target files: cmd/mount.go, cmd/out_db_test.go, internal/fsutil/path.go. - **#818.** A rootless Streamable HTTP client is served the single positional source given to `mache serve`. Before this, only `--stdio` honoured it. A roots-capable session was already served that source (`resolveSource` prefers it), so the HTTP refusal protected nothing. Startup logs what a rootless session will get, and `--path`'s help no longer claims a working-director... (Ref: https://github.com/agentic-research/mache/pull/822)

Fix: fix: graceful error messages when ley-line not available. Target files: cmd/serve_handlers.go, cmd/serve_lsp.go, internal/graph/graph.go. Replace internal error dumps (`discover/start leyline: no ley-line socket found...`) with user-friendly messages when ley-line daemon isn't available: (Ref: https://github.com/agentic-research/mache/pull/153)
